definitions.gloss: scripture; sacred text; sutra; canonical text
definitions.explanation: A religious text that is considered authoritative and sacred, especially Buddhist sutras. Can also refer to the sacred writings of other religions.

examples.japanese: {経典|きょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{経典|きょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}えている→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧。
examples.english: The monk is chanting from the scriptures.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{経典|きょうてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This temple houses a great many ancient scriptures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経典|きょうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サンスクリット⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{漢訳|かんやく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many Buddhist scriptures were translated into Chinese from Sanskrit.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{経|きょう}→経：24866_kyou⟧ (sutra, scripture) and {典|てん} (code, canon, authoritative text). While it can refer to the sacred texts of any religion, it is most commonly used in Buddhist contexts in Japanese.

In Buddhism, the {経典|きょうてん} include the vast body of sutras (⟦{経|きょう}→経：24866_kyou⟧), monastic rules ({律|りつ}), and commentaries (⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧), collectively known as the {三蔵|さんぞう} (Tripitaka). Many of these texts reached Japan via Chinese translation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経典|きょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the scriptures
- {経典|きょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to chant the scriptures
- ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧{経典|きょうてん}: Buddhist scripture
- {経典|きょうてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: study of scriptures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧: sutra, Buddhist chanting — more colloquial and everyday; often refers to the act of chanting rather than the text itself
- ⟦{聖典|せいてん}→聖典：24170_seiten⟧: sacred scripture, holy text — a broader term applicable to any religion; {経典|きょうてん} leans toward Buddhist texts specifically
- ⟦{聖書|せいしょ}→聖書：17969_seisho⟧: the Bible — specifically the Christian scriptures
